data.long_description:
Experience sophisticated city living in the prestigious Imperial Avenue, located in the heart of Downtown Dubai. This beautifully designed 1-bedroom apartment offers an expansive 1,020 sq. ft. layout with contemporary interiors, premium finishes, and exceptional access to Dubai’s most iconic attractions. Perfect for end-users and investors alike, the residence combines luxury, comfort, and convenience in one of the city’s most sought-after addresses.

Property Details:

Tower: Imperial Avenue
Location: Downtown Dubai
Type: Apartment
Bedrooms: 1
Bathrooms: 1
Spacious living and dining area
Floor-to-ceiling windows with natural light
Contemporary fitted kitchen with premium finishes
Large bedroom with built-in wardrobes
Elegant bathroom with modern fixtures
Balcony with community and skyline views
Dedicated parking space

Property Amenities:

Infinity swimming pool
State-of-the-art gymnasium
Children’s play area and pool
Sauna and steam rooms
Landscaped leisure deck
24-hour concierge and security services
High-speed elevators
Covered parking
Multi-purpose lounge and entertainment areas
Smart home features and energy-efficient systems
Retail and dining outlets nearby

Location Highlights:

Prime location in Downtown Dubai
Minutes away from Burj Khalifa
Close to Dubai Mall and Dubai Opera
Easy access to Sheikh Zayed Road and Al Khail Road
Surrounded by luxury hotels, restaurants, and cafés
Approximately 15 minutes from Dubai International Airport
